notes: Entry names describe existing product panels and local component states; only explicitly identified URL/hash entries are claimed as routes.

Source presence alone is not validation; actual screenshots/tests are attached only where performed.
Settings, conversation and shell retain upstream packages through overlay projection; mapped product components are integration/action origins.
Unexecuted per-state visual, interaction and permission checks remain explicit.
Evidence identifies its exact candidate/source revision. Selected final f4 checks and production smoke checks do not claim every state has passed on the final deployed image.
All 62 design records are mapped. This is not a claim that every flow or every role was visually tested pixel-for-pixel. Historical/inherited limits and unexecuted checks remain explicit.
